text: きせつふうに　ながされつつ　しそんを　ふやすため　わたほうしを　せかいの　あちこちに　ばらまく。

structure.jp: きせつふうに　ながされつつ
structure.en: while carried along by seasonal winds

structure.jp: しそんを　ふやすため
わたほうしを　せかいの　あちこちに　ばらまく。
structure.en: it scatters cotton spores all over the world.

patterns.name: 〜つつ
patterns.explanation: つつ after the short form of a verb means 'while doing it', a bookish ながら. ながされつつ = 'while being carried along'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: きせつふうに　ながされ
patterns.explanation: The され in the verb turns 'carry away' into 'be carried away', and に shows what does it. きせつふうに　ながされ = 'carried along by seasonal winds'.

patterns.name: 〜ため
patterns.explanation: ため after a verb means 'in order to do it'. ふやすため = 'in order to increase'.
